question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/557453d63b42c3cc7fcee30bd685a55b8272cbf024aece78010f15d663a4ed5f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic**: One inside figure is added in every step, with a 90-degree clockwise rotation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e84562b6c50d9fb4d847ae3d1e15e5fb514942beb423dbe9a97e89624d538b1c.png] 

The inner figure is rotated by 90 degrees in a clockwise direction and added in each step.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
